description: Defines an Enyo kind for the main window view of a ToDo MVC application, organizing the top-level window with two subcomponents: NotepadView and FooterView.

classes.name: ToDo.WindowView
classes.description: The main top-level window component constructed using the Enyo framework, containing NotepadView and FooterView components.

methods.name: <initialization method>
methods.description: The anonymous object passed to enyo.kind defines configuration for the WindowView class, including component setup. There are no explicitly named methods in the code.
